name: Weekly re-scan of approved Apps
instructionTemplate:
Re-scan the App of this task's project for known vulnerabilities in its code and its dependencies, with the schedule part of the skill vulnerability-scan. Find the governance bundles of this task's own project in the stage Approval, by that project's ID, and file on each one each new real finding. Never look at a bundle of another project. Fill no evidence item.
Schedule: {{schedule.name}}, {{schedule.cron}} ({{schedule.timezone}}), fired for {{schedule.scheduledFor}}
